status: Frozen exploratory definition; prospective validation required
contact_definition: Unique C-C pairs within 0.50 nm, separated by at least four bonds, divided by 50 carbons
hydration_definition: Unique water oxygens within 0.45 nm of any backbone carbon
state_rule: All three conditions must hold simultaneously on trailing-median observables; otherwise undecided
event_rule: Commit after uninterrupted core occupancy for commitment_ps. Undecided frames reset the candidate dwell, not the last committed state. Count C-E-C cycles only after an observed compact commitment.
robust_cycle_rule: A primary cycle must overlap a complete cycle under each of strict thresholds, 500 ps commitment, 50 ps smoothing and 200 ps smoothing. Matching uses expanded core entry to compact core return intervals.
recurrence_rule: Prospective support requires at least two robust complete cycles per replica in at least two of PE25 replicas 2-4. This is a screening heuristic, not a statistical significance test or rate-validation criterion.
